summary: Round 7 testing completed. All 6 backend tests passed. Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in create_order endpoint. All Round 7 features verified via code review and backend tests.

orders_pagination.details: GET /api/orders?page=1 and page=2 return different orders with correct pagination structure (orders, total, page, total_pages)

cancel_order_deducts_points.details: POST /api/orders/{id}/cancel deducts loyalty points equal to order subtotal from user

cancelled_order_fields.details: Cancelled order has status='cancelled', cancelled_at timestamp, and points_deducted field

cart_cleared_after_order.details: After POST /api/orders, cart items are cleared (GET /api/cart returns empty items array)

cancelled_order_tracking.details: GET /api/orders/{id} returns status='cancelled' for cancelled orders

payment_form_4242.details: CheckoutPage.js line 464: Payment form shows defaultValue='4242 4242 4242 4242' with data-testid='card-number'

payment_2s_delay.details: CheckoutPage.js line 124: handleSubmitOrder has 2s delay via setTimeout(resolve, 2000)

cancel_popup_points_warning.details: AccountPage.js lines 374-377: Cancel dialog shows 'Points de fidélité' section with 'Vous perdrez X points'

cancel_popup_refund_info.details: AccountPage.js lines 370-373: Cancel dialog shows 'Remboursement' section with '10 jours ouvrés'

address_edit_dialog.details: AccountPage.js line 607: Address edit uses <Dialog> component, not browser prompt()

order_tracking_cancelled_state.details: OrderTrackingPage.js lines 207, 231-240: Shows 'Annulée' status and cancelled state with refund info

frontend_compiles.details: Frontend compiles with only deprecation warnings and React hooks linting warnings (no errors)

bug_fixed.issue: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error in create_order endpoint
bug_fixed.root_cause: After db.orders.insert_one(order), MongoDB adds _id field to the order dict which is not JSON serializable
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added order.pop('_id', None) after insert_one to remove _id before returning response

seed_data_creation: Multiple test users created during pytest runs for isolated testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 7 features all implemented and tested: 1) Orders pagination works correctly with page parameter, 2) Order cancel deducts loyalty points (points_deducted stored in order), 3) Cancelled orders have status='cancelled', cancelled_at, points_deducted fields, 4) Cart is cleared after order submission, 5) Payment form shows fake 4242 card with 2s delay simulation, 6) Address edit uses Dialog component (not browser prompt), 7) Cancel popup shows points warning and refund info, 8) OrderTrackingPage shows cancelled state with 'Annulée' and refund info. Bug fixed: MongoDB ObjectId serialization in create_order endpoint.
